skills.name: Snake Sense
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates when the stage target appears. Affects all allies. ATK ▲ 12.99% for 10 sec. Hit Rate ▲ 5.56% for 10 sec.

skills.name: Snake Scale
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Affects self. Hit Rate ▲ 1.71% continuously. ■ Activates when entering Full Burst. Affects self. Vamp: Prevents being targeted by single-target attacks for 10 sec. This effect is removed upon taking a direct hit. Invulnerable for 1 sec.

skills.name: Snake Bite
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Affects 1 designated enemy unit(s). Deals 231.42% of final ATK as damage. ■ Affects the enemy if the enemy is the stage target. DEF ▼ 9.91% for 10 sec.
